item.title: Version 1.0.0 (Build 39)
item.description:
send2adf Tool Integration

  • Updated ADF floppy disk image generation to use native C-based send2adf instead of xdftool.
  • Faster, lightweight bootable floppy creation without external Python dependencies.

item.title: Version 1.0.0 (Build 38)
item.description:
Sparkle updates

  • Added signed automatic updates and a Check for Updates command.
  • Embedded the Sparkle framework and connected the release feed.
  • Repaired the release pipeline for the bundled MLX server helper.
